[1/5] Build transcript ingestion: parse VTT/SRT/Podcasting 2.0 JSON/HTML/plain text, extract YouTube captions, discover Podcasting 2.0 transcripts from RSS feeds, and fetch direct transcript URLs; cover with mocked-network unit tests.

impact_assessment.why: NeuralDeck can only build cards from local documents; users want podcast and YouTube sources turned into cards without manual copy-paste.
impact_assessment.benefits: Adds podcast RSS and YouTube URL sources plus transcript-file support, reusing the existing chunking/card pipeline and keeping processing local.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new public media module consumed by UI and document_processor; dependency: youtube-transcript-api/defusedxml, optional faster-whisper; concurrency: UI import runs on a worker thread; state: imported transcript held in memory only, no new persisted fields.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure parsers separated from network fetches, lazy optional imports, bounded downloads/timeouts, mocked-network tests, and UI updates marshalled with after().

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Re-plan: deliver media transcript import as one atomic change (transcript parsers, YouTube/podcast fetchers, optional local Whisper, UI import flow, docs) because intermediate commits cannot pass the README tree and codebase-map gate separately.

impact_assessment.why: The original five milestones share one public surface and one documentation tree; splitting them would leave intermediate commits with stale maps and incomplete README trees.
impact_assessment.benefits: One reviewable change with a single test/gate run and an exact rollback point.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: media API and UI run_process signature change together; dependency: new runtime packages and optional Whisper; concurrency: URL import uses a worker thread; state: no persisted transcript state.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the pure parsers separate, mock all network calls in tests, lazy-load optional audio support, and run the project check on the complete tree.

[1/1] Add podcast episode browsing and transcript preview: expose the feed's transcribed episodes, let the user pick one, fetch only that transcript, and show an in-app preview before generating cards.

impact_assessment.why: The feed import currently picks the newest transcribed episode automatically, so users cannot choose a specific episode or inspect the imported text before spending LLM time.
impact_assessment.benefits: Makes podcast ingestion predictable and reviewable, reuses one feed parse, and downloads only the chosen transcript.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: PodcastTranscriptRef gains episode_url and new public feed functions; dependency: none; concurrency: feed fetch and transcript fetch stay on worker threads while dialogs run on the UI thread; state: selected episode remains in memory only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep parsing pure, preserve existing parse/fetch behavior for callers, mock all network calls in tests, and verify the UI with a headless smoke run.
